source.author: cic
source.text: non abnuo, non recuso, vosque obsecro, iudices, ut vestra beneficia quae in me contulistis aut in huius salute augeatis aut in eiusdem exitio occasura esse videatis.
source.text_original: non abnuo, non recuso, vosque obsecro, iudices, ut vestra beneficia quae in me contulistis aut in huius salute augeatis aut in eiusdem exitio occasura esse videatis.
source.text_english: I do not refuse, I do not decline, and I beg you, judges, that the favors you have bestowed on me either may be increased in the saving of this man, or else you may see that they are going to fall to the ground in his destruction.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: ecce dominus in euangelio cingitur linteo, peluem ad lauandos pedes discipulorum praeparat, serui fungitur ministerio; esto, doceat humilitatem, ut nobis inuicem ministremus: non abnuo, non recuso.
reuse.text_original: ecce dominus in euangelio cingitur linteo, peluem ad lauandos pedes discipulorum praeparat, serui fungitur ministerio; esto, doceat humilitatem, ut nobis inuicem ministremus: non abnuo, non recuso.
reuse.text_english: Behold, the Lord in the Gospel is girded with a linen cloth, prepares a basin for washing the feet of the disciples, and performs the service of a slave; granted, let him teach humility, so that we may minister to one another: I do not deny it, I do not refuse it.
